purpose: Rhythm-game tap chart with inferred beat tracking and onset-selected subdivisions; not a transcription of pitched instruments
timingReference: Seconds from the beginning of the original MP3; use HTMLAudioElement.currentTime
syncMethod: Fit stable global tempo to source beat tracker; review each 16-beat segment and apply bounded, smoothed correction; onset-confirmed subdivisions
phaseNote: Beat 1 bar alignment is automatically inferred and may need adjustment by listening. Beat 2 is accentuated relative to that inferred phase.

silenceFilter.description: Skip notes in near-silent sections; quiet beats retained where rhythm remains clear.
